# v4.2.0 Security hardening

Fork of cpulxb/WSL-Image-Clipboard-Helper focused on local trust-boundary issues.

- Stop shipping `.exe` / AutoHotkey runtimes in git
- Store screenshots in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\WSLImageClipboardHelper` with a tightened ACL
- Expire temp PNGs after 30 minutes
- Explorer file conversion is image-only unless opted in
- Filter pasted paths that contain control characters, backticks, or `$`
- Manifest requests `asInvoker`
- Release workflow publishes only from `v*` tags and never clobbers existing releases
- AutoHotkey helpers are deprecated and path-confined
